title: Google Business Profiles in 2026: Win the Map Pack | Eclincher

facts.fact: Eclincher reports analyzing internal data across 14,000 local business locations for its Google Business Profile findings.
facts.quote: After analyzing internal Eclincher data across 14,000 local business locations, the results were clear.

facts.fact: According to Eclincher's internal data, organizations using centralized listing synchronization saw a 28% increase in 'Discovery' search views within 90 days compared to businesses managing listings through separate native logins.
facts.unit: % increase in Discovery search views within 90 days
facts.quote: Organizations using centralized listing synchronization saw a 28% increase in “Discovery” search views within 90 days

facts.fact: The article 'Google Business Profiles in 2026: Winning the Local Map Pack' was published on February 11, 2026.

The article's illustrative holiday-hours scenario describes a regional manager finding 45 of 120 franchise locations still showing regular hours during a federal holiday; this is a hypothetical example, not reported data.
facts.quote: A regional manager discovers that 45 out of 120 franchise locations still show regular business hours during a federal holiday.

facts.fact: The article describes a three-step Google Business Profile optimization loop consisting of Capture, Categorize, and Calibrate.
facts.quote: The 3-Step Google Business Profile Optimization Loop

facts.fact: In the article's platform comparison table, Eclincher's review categorization is rated 'AI-Driven' while Hootsuite's, Zoho's, and AgoraPulse's are rated 'Manual'; these are the vendor's own qualitative ratings.
facts.quote: | **Review Categorization** | AI-Driven | Manual | None | Manual | Partial | Manual |
